name: form-10
title: Form 10
description: A short bio field with character limits.

meta.prompt:
Create a minimal single-field form for bio, filling available width up to 384px. Stack the “Bio” label, a multiline textarea, and a compact primary Submit button with 16px spacing between the field and button. Use neutral theme-aware borders, rounded controls, and visible keyboard focus.

Trim surrounding whitespace and require 20–160 characters. Start with an empty value, validate on submission, and show field errors beneath the control with invalid styling and an accessible invalid state. Associate the label with the control. A valid submission stays on the form without a success screen or external action.
